mapper.insert: INSERT INTO artifact (artifact_id, workspace_id, data_type, schema_name, schema_version, status, description, retention_until, protected_flag, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{artifactId}, #{workspaceId}, #{dataType}, #{schemaName}, #{schemaVersion}, #{status}, #{description}, #{retentionUntil}, #{protectedFlag}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})

INSERT INTO artifact_file (file_id, artifact_id, internal_name, root_key, relative_path, media_type, size_bytes, checksum_algorithm, checksum, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{artifactId}, #{internalName}, #{rootKey}, #{relativePath}, #{mediaType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{checksumAlgorithm}, #{checksum}, #{deletedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})

INSERT INTO artifact_set (set_id, workspace_id, name, purpose, description, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{setId}, #{workspaceId}, #{name}, #{purpose}, #{description}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})

INSERT INTO artifact_set_version (version_id, set_id, version_number, status, item_count, composition_checksum, confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{setId}, #{versionNumber}, #{status}, #{itemCount}, #{compositionChecksum}, #{confirmedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})

INSERT INTO artifact_set_member (version_id, artifact_id, ordinal, source_key, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{artifactId}, #{ordinal}, #{sourceKey}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM artifact WHERE artifact_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM artifact_set WHERE set_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM artifact_set_version WHERE version_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM artifact WHERE workspace_id = #{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC, artifact_id
SELECT * FROM artifact_set WHERE workspace_id = #{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC, set_id
SELECT * FROM artifact_file WHERE artifact_id = #{id} ORDER BY internal_name, file_id
SELECT * FROM artifact_set_version WHERE set_id = #{id} ORDER BY version_number
SELECT * FROM artifact_set_member WHERE version_id = #{id} ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT * FROM artifact_file WHERE artifact_id = #{artifactId} AND file_id = #{fileId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_number), 0) + 1 FROM artifact_set_version WHERE set_id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE artifact SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE artifact_id = #{id}

UPDATE artifact_set_version SET status = 'CONFIRMED', item_count = #{count}, composition_checksum = #{checksum}, confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE version_id = #{id}
